findings.source: NFTMetadataGenerator: string(abi.encodePacked(...)) of many pieces, then Base64.encode(bytes(svg)) (Base64.sol:75 for {} lt(dataPtr, endPtr) {} {...})
findings.issue: The address of each concatenated string is printed as the full sum of all earlier lengths (a 120-character expression repeated a dozen times per line group), so the Base64 loop and the copies are very hard to follow although their shape is right.
findings.rule: Name a memory pointer once where it is computed (the start of each abi.encodePacked result, the Base64 table and output) and use the name in later addresses and loop bounds.

findings.function: tokenURI(uint256) (Strings.toString with constant and variable arguments)
findings.source: Strings.sol:53 while (true) { ptr--; mstore8(ptr, byte(mod(value, 10), HEX_DIGITS)); value /= 10; if (value == 0) break; }  called as Strings.toString(250), (30), (22) and (tokenId)
findings.issue: The do-while is printed rotated (the first digit stored before the loop, P3) and the calls with constant arguments keep a loop although the result is the constant string ('250'); calldata read past its end prints as cd[calldata.size] instead of 0.
findings.rule: A do-while 'body; if c: break' prints as one loop with its test at the end; a loop with constant inputs and only memory effects on fresh memory can be evaluated; cd[x] with x >= calldata.size is 0.

findings.source: StakingGraph.sol:167 graph[index] = (uint256(ad) & DELTA_MASK) | uint256(ap << DELTA_BITS); :185-204 while (index > 0) { ... index := sub(index, and(index, sub(0, index))) }
findings.issue: '(-amount * expiration) << 112' prints as a multiplication by the decimal constant -2^112, the packed product is split as (x << 112) + ((p >> 112) << 112), the query loop carries two copies of the index (s and t), and the sign-bit test keeps a useless '<< 111'.
findings.rule: Print x * 2^k as x << k (and constants 2^k as 2**k); (a << k) + ((b >> k) << k) is (a + (b >> k)) << k; merge loop variables that always hold the same value; in a boolean context (bit << k) is bit.

notes: Source loops: StakingGraph.addStake while (581), update while (605/618 and 1679/1696), query while (326/340), Base64._encode Yul for (2680, 2739), NFTMetadataGenerator._generateTokenIdText outer and inner for (2199, 2210), Strings.toString while(true) (2131 etc., rotated); all shown as while. The pack's Strings.toString section shows the wrong source text (ReentrancyGuardTransient); the loop was checked in lib/openzeppelin-contracts/contracts/utils/Strings.sol. Semantics checked: addStake's power-of-two rounding and copy loop, update's packing and range requires, query, the redemption arithmetic, ERC721 enumerable updates, tokenURI pieces. 44 ABI functions read; tokenURI (700 lines) by structure.
summary: All seven source loops are found and the semantics match; readability suffers from huge unnamed pointer sums in the tokenURI string building, rotated toString loops (even on constants) and arithmetic printed with -2^112 as a decimal factor.
